judgments.reason: Paper reports the 12-class SSVEP dataset (simulated online BCI) matching this dataset's 12 classes and authors; the dataset's own DOI field points to this paper.

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for converting/organizing data into BIDS, used to curate the dataset; it does not describe the Nakanishi 2015 SSVEP data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/standard extension to BIDS used to organize this dataset, not a paper describing the Nakanishi 2015 SSVEP recordings.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
